text: First of all, this idea that most men walk around assuming all women want to sleep with them is pure fantasy. Most guys are just shooting their shot and seeing where it goes, prepared to be ignored or rejected. And as I say in my other videos, in recent history, it has probably never been harder for an average guy to meet women, get dates, or build anything romantic. So this picture of most men being overconfident and delusional doesn't match reality at all. Now the second part is where it gets interesting. The moment someone says, if you want to talk to this, you got to spend or do something, we're no longer talking about confidence or boundaries. We're talking about turning basic human interaction into a transaction. You don't need to put a label on it, but when attention, conversation, or access comes with a price tag, I think we all know what it's called. And guys, here's the key takeaway. If you meet a woman like this in real life, don't take her seriously. And even if you have enough money to talk to her, you can probably spend that money better elsewhere.
